summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a strategic investment agreement to acquire a 2% equity interest in PredicXion Group Limited (K25.ai) at a pre-money valuation of $100M. Consideration is $1M cash (or stablecoin/Solana) plus 666,667 newly issued NIVF Class A shares at $1.50/share. An option allows up to an additional 8% (total 10%) at the same valuation, with a forced exercise of at least 4% if NIVF conducts certain AI-related fundraises. Closing within 2 days of definitive documents, subject to due diligence. Watch for completion of due diligence and exercise of option as the key catalyst.
